_comment: Stage B/C (2026-11-03): same flight/gust settings as stage A (hover_gust.json) plus the policy action limits, reward and termination. Axis = PX4 NED y (east), see rl_demo/contracts.py.

gust._comment: 2026-11-03 wide: |F| log-uniform 0.03..0.6 N (fan-like weak to 1.3x the old max), half 1-3 s pulses, half 5-12 s steady winds (fan-like)

policy._comment: target offset east limited to +-0.2 m, at most 0.1 m per 0.1 s policy step

reward._comment: r = -(e/0.05)^2 - 0.1 (v/0.3)^2 - 0.02 (delta/dmax)^2 - 0.05 (ddelta/step)^2, per 0.1 s, from the TRUTH

terminate._comment: estimate |east error| > 0.5 m ends the window early (terminal, penalty)

valid._comment: episodes below this window real-time factor are not used for an update (logged)
